name: Ring Band Creation Script - USA sizes Customizer

captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classic, plain band ring with a flat inner surface and a rounded, dome-shaped outer profile, resembling a traditional wedding band. It has a chunky thickness and a moderate width, showing a faceted surface finish due to low-polygon rendering settings. The ring is completely symmetric around its central axis with no additional embellishments, stones, or engravings visible in this configuration.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric wedding ring band in OpenSCAD. The script should allow the user to input a US/Canada numerical ring size, adjust the wall thickness (main_wall) and band width (main_depth), and select from multiple cross-sectional profile shapes such as pill, ellipse, and rectangle.
captions.factory: The code generates the ring by performing a 2D-to-3D transform using the rotate_extrude() function. It translates a 2D profile shape, chosen from various options like 'cs_half_pill' or 'cs_pill' via conditional if-else statements, along the X-axis by half of the calculated inner diameter. The inner diameter is derived from the US/Canada numerical ring size using a linear formula. Additionally, the script includes a module for optional text engraving or raising using the external writecylinder library.
